solution:
import os

def generate_project_scaffold_files(target_dir: str) -> bool:
    os.makedirs(target_dir, exist_ok=True)
    gitignore_content = ".venv/\n__pycache__/\n*.pyc\n*.mp4\n*.wav\ndist/\n.DS_Store\n"
    req_content = "numpy>=1.26.0\nmatplotlib>=3.8.0\nopencv-python>=4.9.0\npillow>=10.2.0\nscipy>=1.12.0\n"
    
    with open(os.path.join(target_dir, '.gitignore'), 'w') as f:
        f.write(gitignore_content)
    with open(os.path.join(target_dir, 'requirements.txt'), 'w') as f:
        f.write(req_content)
    return True
